value.rationale: A natural and financially relevant exponentially increasing reset penalty is finite for every alpha>0 but divergent at Brownian alpha=0; merely noting finiteness hides an enormous resource liability near the physical limit. The exact critical inverse-alpha-log law and full supercritical exponentially remote saddle quantify this boundary and separate the two physical rare-excursion mechanisms. This is a motivated missing asymptotic in a contemporary nonequilibrium model, not a normalization check or arbitrary slice.
